_comment: Mini CVE knowledge base — offline fallback + demo data. Real CVEs with real CVSS scores from public sources. Used when the CIRCL API is unreachable or rate-limited.

cves.summary: Backdoor in xz-utils 5.6.0/5.6.1 (liblzma) — RCE via SSH, supply-chain compromise. Debian/Ubuntu/Fedora affected.
HTTP/2 Rapid Reset — request smuggling/DoS affecting nginx, Apache, and many load balancers.
Heap buffer overflow in libwebp — exploited in the wild (zero-day), affects Chrome, WhatsApp, and many apps.
Spring4Shell — RCE via data binding in Spring MVC/WebFlux (JDK 9+), wildly exploited within days.
Log4Shell — unauthenticated RCE via JNDI lookup in Log4j 2.x (2.0-2.14.1). The most exploited CVE of the 2020s.
Apache 2.4.49 path traversal + RCE (alias-based). Fixed in 2.4.50/2.4.51.
BlueKeep — pre-auth RCE in RDP (Windows 7/2008/XP). Wormable; msf exploit available.
EternalBlue — SMBv1 RCE used by WannaCry/NotPetya. Patch MS17-010.
Integer overflow in nginx range filter (0.5.6-1.13.2) — response cache poisoning / data leak.
PHPMailer < 5.2.18 — object injection/RCE widely abused by phishing spam campaigns.
Heartbleed — memory disclosure in OpenSSL 1.0.1 (before 1.0.1g). Leaks private keys/session data.
Zerologon — Netlogon elevation of privilege (DC takeover) in under 10 seconds without creds.
MOVEit Transfer SQL injection — one of the largest data-theft campaigns in history (CL0P).
PaperCut MF/NG auth bypass (RCE in print server software, exploited in the wild).
SQL Server Reporting Services — RCE via deserialization (Windows Server 2008-2019).
Microsoft Outlook NTLM relay — zero-click privilege escalation, exploited in the wild.
PAN-OS GlobalProtect command injection — unauthenticated RCE, exploited in the wild within days.
nftables use-after-free — local privilege escalation on most Linux kernels < 6.7.2 (no KASLR bypass needed).
Docker Engine context leak in Buildx — local info disclosure (representative 2025 entry).
OverlayFS user namespace kernel bug — local privilege escalation, exploited in the wild.
Meta React Server Components RCE — exploited in the wild, ransomware-flagged, EPSS 100% (CISA KEV 2026).
CitrixBleed 2 — NetScaler ADC/Gateway session token leak; 11.5M+ attack attempts within weeks (CISA KEV July 2025).
SolarWinds Web Help Desk deserialization RCE — exploited in the wild, ransomware used (CISA KEV).
Fortra GoAnywhere MFT deserialization RCE — exploited in the wild, ransomware-flagged (CISA KEV).
Progress LoadMaster command injection — exploited in the wild, EPSS 99% (CISA KEV August 2026).
JetBrains TeamCity relative path traversal — exploited in the wild, ransomware-flagged (CISA KEV).
F5 BIG-IP APM authentication bypass — exploited in the wild; part of 2025's most-exploited named CVEs.
